subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept this operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect-drain behavior as the compatibility-safe fix for the linked QQBot outbound message-loss regression?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes generic channel delivery selection and queued reconnect replay behavior where green tests cannot fully decide the product compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve after final gate refresh
options.body: Accept the delivery-only resolver split and QQBot drain, then rerun or waive the failed OpenGrep install failure before merge.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for the resolver alignment only and defer reconnect-drain replay behavior if maintainers want less queued-delivery surface in this PR.

options.title: Pause for API direction
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader channel capability contract before adding another resolver entry point.

recommendation.title: Approve after final gate refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the delivery-only resolver split and QQBot drain, then rerun or waive the failed OpenGrep install failure before merge.
